about.title: About Me
about.lead: I am a Senior Backend Engineer with 12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend platforms and distributed systems across enterprise and product engineering environments.
about.body: My core strength is building production-grade microservices and transaction-critical backend services using Node.js, Java Spring Boot, Python, and Go, with a strong focus on cloud-native delivery, observability, and long-term production stability.

philosophy.title: Engineering Philosophy
items: Prefer scalable, debuggable systems over unnecessary complexity
Design backend services for failure, concurrency, and graceful recovery
Use clear service boundaries and event-driven patterns to reduce coupling
Treat observability, performance, and operability as core design concerns
Own systems end-to-end from architecture review to production support

currentFocus.title: Current Focus
achievements: Designing enterprise-scale backend systems and distributed microservices for high-volume workflows
Building microservices using Node.js and Java Spring Boot for scalable backend platforms and APIs
Implementing Kafka-based event-driven services across distributed environments
Deploying cloud-native backend services on AWS with Lambda, ECS, and API Gateway
Reducing AWS Lambda layer size by around 55% to improve cold-start and runtime efficiency
Strengthening production observability using CloudWatch and Datadog
